    StartersHam and cheddar sandwiches, apple, nutsHam, cheddar and relish triangles, sliced red apples and a cone of mixed nutsHow to make it8 slices of white bread30g butter, soft150g leg ham150g cheddar, sliced2 tbsp pickle relish2 red apples, sliced150g mixed nutsButter the bread and fill with the ham, cheddar and relish. Cut into triangles.Slice the apples and twist the nuts into paper cones.Pack it all together like a lunch hidden away in a school attic.Swamp of Sadness spinach cob loafThe swamp where Atreyu loses ArtaxHow to make itAs written, serves 4Spinach, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and garlic baked bubbling inside a hollowed cob loaf, with the torn bread toasted for dipping.Cut the top off a cob loaf and hollow it out, tearing the inside into chunks.Mix 250g thawed spinach squeezed dry, 250g cream cheese, 200g sour cream, 50g grated parmesan, a crushed garlic clove and pepper.Fill the loaf, replace the lid and wrap in foil.Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes, adding the bread chunks to the tray for the last 10 minutes.Serve warm.MainsUrgl's healing soupChicken, pearl barley and vegetable soup with parsley and lemonHow to make it600g chicken thighs100g pearl barley2 carrots, diced1 leek, sliced2 celery sticks, sliced1.5 L water2 tbsp chopped parsley1 tbsp lemon juicesalt, to tasteChop the vegetables.Simmer the chicken with the barley, carrots, leek and celery in the water for an hour.Shred the chicken back into the pot, then stir through the parsley and lemon juice and season with salt to taste. Serve with brown bread.Ivory Tower tarragon roast chickenThe Childlike Empress in her Ivory TowerHow to make itAs written, serves 4Whole chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and tarragon and roasted golden, with silky white bean mash, buttered leeks and the pan juices.Mix 60g soft butter with chopped tarragon, lemon zest and salt and rub under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken.Roast at 200°C for 75 minutes.Warm 2 drained cans of cannellini beans with a garlic clove and 100ml stock, then blitz with 30g butter until smooth.Slice 2 leeks and cook gently in 30g butter for 10 minutes.Rest the chicken and spoon over the pan juices.SweetsFalkor cloud meringuesBig crisp meringues with whipped cream and strawberriesHow to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar300ml thickened cream, whipped250g strawberriesWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy.Spoon big fluffy clouds onto lined trays and bake at 100°C for 90 minutes. Cool in the oven.Serve with whipped cream and strawberries.Rockbiter's chocolate almond rocksDark chocolate, marshmallow, almond and coconut chunks, chilled and smashedHow to make it300g dark chocolate150g marshmallows100g roasted almonds100g sweet biscuits, broken1/2 cup desiccated coconutMelt the chocolate. Stir in the marshmallows, almonds, biscuits and coconut.Press into a lined tray and chill for 2 hours.Smash into rough chunky rocks with the handle of a knife.DrinksSouthern Oracle teaChamomile and lemon peel tea with honey, hot or iced with apple juiceHow to make it4 chamomile tea bags1 L boiling water1 strip lemon peel2 tbsp honey500ml apple juice, optional for the cold versionBrew the tea bags with the lemon peel in the boiling water for 5 minutes.Stir in the honey. Serve warm in small cups, or cool it and mix half and half with apple juice over ice.Cold strawberry milkBastian shouts Moon Child out the window.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
